content.problem: Distributed cache stampede caused connection pool starvation during spike.
content.cause: Unsynchronized multi-tenant cache warming requests hitting origin PostgreSQL.
content.fix: Deployed single-flight mutex deduplication with probabilistic early expiration.
content.lesson: Always gate origin read queries behind singleflight mutex barriers.
